hero.logo_alt: Helping Hands Lab logo: a robot gripper and a human hand reaching for each other
hero.lede: We are the Helping Hands Lab at Northeastern University.
hero.body: We develop perception, planning, and control algorithms for robot manipulation in unstructured environments. We are particularly interested in robots that work with humans in built-for-human environments.

join.intro: We are always looking for people who work at the intersection of robotics and machine learning.

openings.title: Postdoc and PhD positions
openings.body: Funded postdoc and PhD positions are available in the Helping Hands Lab at Northeastern University for students who work at the intersection of robotics and machine learning. To apply, please email your CV to Robert Platt.

openings.title: Master's, undergraduate, and visiting students
openings.body: The Helping Hands Lab always welcomes Master's, undergraduate, and visiting students. If you would like to join us, the best first step is to contact the PhD student whose research interests you most and ask what they are working on.
